title: ABAP
description: Работа с ABAP: система SAP доступна агентам только на чтение через MCP, код переносит и транспорты создаёт владелец. Без git worktree, если репозиторий не на abapGit.

members.instructions: Use the read-only SAP MCP servers to study the objects involved. List every ABAP object (type + name) the change touches. Parallel teams must not touch the same objects.

The SAP system is read-only for you. Deliver the complete source of every changed or new ABAP object as `code` artifacts (one per object, named like zcl_foo.clas.abap), plus a short transfer guide (order of objects, activation notes). With abapGit repos, commit the files instead.

Review the ABAP code artifacts against clean ABAP guidelines and the current system state (read via MCP): syntax plausibility, naming, performance (SELECT in loops, buffering), authorisation checks, and that only agreed objects change.

relations.note: the plan and the list of objects are ready
the work is submitted for review
